sources.title: Qwen2.5 - a Qwen Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 language models, including pretrained and instruction-tuned models of 7 sizes, including 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B.

sources.title: qwen2.5:7b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 models are pretrained on Alibaba's latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18 trillion tokens. The model supports up to 128K tokens and has multilingual support.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.

sources.title: Zatomic AI | Qwen2.5 7B
sources.snippet: Use Qwen2.5 7B to improve your prompts with innovative tools like prompt scoring, risk analysis, structural balance, and prompt heatmaps. Schedule 15-minute call View the docs
